excerpt.en: Why curiosity, problem-solving, and critical thinking begin in the early years.
excerpt.id: Mengapa rasa ingin tahu dan berpikir kritis dimulai sejak dini.

author: Dr. Amelia Hartono
body:
STEM is not a subject reserved for older students. In the early years it is a way of wondering: What happens if…? and How could we…?

Start with questions

When children test ideas with blocks, water, and ramps, they are doing engineering. Our teachers protect that curiosity and give it vocabulary.

Curiosity is the curriculum.

What families can do

  • Wonder aloud together.
  • Let children retry without fixing it for them.
  • Celebrate the question, not just the answer.

excerpt.en: Middle School teams presented semester-long projects to real community audiences.
excerpt.id: Tim SMP mempresentasikan proyek semester kepada audiens komunitas nyata.

author: Raka Wijaya
body:
This semester, Studio teams shipped work to real audiences: a water audit for a local NGO, a redesigned school garden, and an oral-history archive with alumni.

Why it matters

When the audience is real, feedback is real — and so is the learning. Students iterated, reflected, and transferred skills back to their classes.

title.en: Service in Action: A Literacy Partnership

excerpt.en: How a decade-long partnership with Yayasan Baca keeps growing — in both directions.
excerpt.id: Bagaimana kemitraan satu dekade dengan Yayasan Baca terus tumbuh — dua arah.

author: Sari Dewi
body:
Since 2012, our students have read alongside children at Yayasan Baca. What began as a weekly visit is now a shared program the partners design together.

Reciprocal by design

Service learning works when both communities teach and both learn. Our students gain empathy and agency; our partners gain resources and voice.

title.en: Alumni Story: Conservation in the Coral Triangle
title.id: Kisah Alumni: Konservasi di Segitiga Terumbu Karang

excerpt.en: A graduate returns to Jakarta to talk about reef restoration and starting young.
excerpt.id: Seorang alumni kembali ke Jakarta untuk berbicara tentang restorasi terumbu karang.

author: Communications Team
body:
When our alumnus Rafael returned to campus, he told students that conservation began with a school club and a stubborn question.

Start where you are

His message: you do not need to wait until you are older to do work that matters. Begin with what you can see, and build from there.
